predictions.mechanism: Persistently low claims reinforce a resilient labor-market narrative, which can keep Fed tightening expectations and front-end yields firm, mildly pressuring duration-sensitive technology shares.
predictions.invalidation: A sharp decline in Treasury yields or clear dovish Fed repricing would invalidate the mild bearish call.

predictions.mechanism: Labor resilience marginally supports higher-for-longer rate expectations, a modest headwind for broad equity valuations in an already high-yield environment.
predictions.invalidation: A broad risk-on move accompanied by falling yields would invalidate the mild bearish call.

predictions.mechanism: Resilient employment can support Treasury yields and reduce urgency for Fed easing, creating a mild headwind for non-yielding gold despite geopolitical support.
predictions.invalidation: A sharp fall in yields or renewed geopolitical escalation would invalidate the mild bearish call.
